name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  JULY  22, 2025

CALLTO  ORDER  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order at
  5:30 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Vice  Mayor  Joshua Barron,  Council  Member  Gil
  Hurtado  and Council  Member  Al Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La Paz,
  City  Manager  Rob Houston,  City Attorney  Rail  F. Salinas

  Council  Member  Maria  del Pilar Avalos  requested  she be allowed  to
  participate  in the City  Council  Meeting  remotely  due to medical  condition
  and consistent  with  AB  2449.  The request  was approved  by motion  of
  Mayor  Davila  and seconded  by Council  Member  Rios.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos  abstained;  Council  Member
  Hurtado,  yes; Council  Member  Rios,  yes; Vice Mayor  Barron,  yes; Mayor
  Davila,  yes.

PERSONNEL  RECRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  considered  receiving  and filing  the list of new and
  promoted  full-time  employees  hired  or promoted  during  June 2025.

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 5:45 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 6:35 p.m. with  all Members  of Council  present.  City
  Attorney  Salinas  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Goverent  Code Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representatron:  Rob Houston,  City  Manager

  Unrepresented  Employees:  Top Management/Department  Directors
  Hourly  Employees

  Employee  Organizations:  SGMEA,  SGPMMA,  SGDMA,  SGPOA,
  SGPMA

  On item 1, the City  Council  received  a presentation  from  the City
  Manager  discussing  ongoing  labor negotiations.  At the conclusion  of that
  presentation,  there was no reportable  action  taken.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF JULY  22, 2025
